lines.en: Honey, you made the bet again.
I told you, you don't have to do that.
This isn't camp.
Oh, then I guess the panty raid last night
was totally uncalled for.
Okay, I am going to take a shower,
and today I will be singing Jim Crowchey's "Leroy Brown."
Monica!
Hey, Ma, I have a question.
Is Leroy the baddest man in the whole damn town
or the fattest man in the whole damn town?
The baddest.
Otherwise, the song would be "Fat, Fat, Leroy Brown."
What are you doing?
I'm just waiting for you, sweetie.
Are you remaking the bad?
I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You know what, the way you did it,
it was just fine.
Then you're redoing it because?
If I tell you, you'll think I'm crazy.
You're pretty much running that risk either way.
Okay, you see,
the duvet tag
shouldn't be at the top left corner.
It should be at the bottom right corner.
Oh. Well, that's not so crazy.
I'm just easing you in.
All right.
All right, you see these little flower blossoms?
They should be facing up, not down,
because, well, the head of the bed
is where the sun would be.
You don't love me anymore, do you?
Actually, if it's possible, I love you more.
Really?
Hmm.
Wow.
Well, then come on.
I want to show you how to fold
the toilet paper into a point.
